name: Tool calling: how models use tools

slides.title: Coming soon: Tool calling
slides.summary: How a model that can only write text gets things done: it asks your code to run a tool. This chapter is on its way.
body: A model can only write text. Tool calling lets it ask your code to run something, like a search, a calculator or an API, and read the result before it answers.
